items.heading: A Lot of Content
items.text: A lot of content on this topic oversells the skill-first shift. It is real, but it is not uniform, and pretending otherwise sets people up for a painful surprise mid-job-search.

items.heading: These Six Lanes Were Chosen
items.text: These six lanes were chosen because each one has real, current hiring demand in India for people without a degree, not because they sound exciting on a listicle. Each has a distinct proof format, entry cost, and honest ceiling.

items.heading: Applicant Tracking Systems At Large
items.text: Applicant tracking systems at large corporates auto-filter resumes on a degree field before a human ever sees them.

items.heading: Campus Placement Drives, By Definition,
items.text: Campus placement drives, by definition, only reach people enrolled in a degree program.

items.heading: Government and Public
items.text: Government and public-sector jobs almost always list a specific degree as a hard eligibility line, not a preference.

items.heading: Family and Social Pressure Treats
items.text: Family and social pressure treats "no degree" as a red flag long before an employer ever gets the chance to judge your actual skill.
